requirements.statement: A Trainee can sign in securely so their nutrition and workout data is private to them.

criteria.must: A user must sign in before reaching any tracking screen
A signed-in Trainee cannot view another Trainee's logs or targets

requirements.statement: A Trainee can set their daily calorie and macro (protein, carbs, fat) targets.

criteria.must: A Trainee can submit a daily calorie and macro target
The saved target is shown back to the Trainee with the values they entered

requirements.statement: A Trainee can change their targets whenever their goal changes.

criteria.must: A Trainee can submit a new target that supersedes a previous one
The daily summary reflects the most recently set target

requirements.statement: A Trainee can log a food they ate with its macros.

criteria.must: A Trainee can submit a food entry with calories, protein, carbs and fat
A logged food entry appears in the Trainee's food log

requirements.statement: A Trainee can manually enter a food's calories and macros when logging it.

criteria.must: A Trainee can enter calories, protein, carbs and fat by hand when logging a food
The manually entered macros are what is saved and shown back for that entry

requirements.statement: A Trainee can log a workout with exercises (sets/reps/weight, or duration for cardio).

criteria.must: A Trainee can submit a workout with one or more exercises specifying sets, reps and weight
A Trainee can submit a cardio exercise specifying a duration instead of sets/reps/weight
A logged workout appears in the Trainee's workout history

requirements.statement: A Trainee can see a daily summary of macros logged so far against their targets.

criteria.must: The daily summary totals the calories and macros of all foods logged that day
The daily summary shows the totals against the Trainee's active target

requirements.statement: A Trainee can see a weekly view of their nutrition and workout history.

criteria.must: A Trainee can open a weekly view showing nutrition history across the week
The weekly view shows workout activity across the same period

requirements.statement: A Trainee can invite a Coach to oversee their progress.

criteria.must: A Trainee can generate a coach invite
The generated invite can be shared as a code the Coach enters

requirements.statement: A Trainee can revoke a Coach's access to their data.

criteria.must: A Trainee can revoke an active coach link
After revocation the Coach can no longer view that Trainee's logs or progress

requirements.statement: A Coach can accept a Trainee's invite to start overseeing them.

criteria.must: A Coach can enter a Trainee's invite code and become linked
An invalid or expired invite code is refused with a clear error

requirements.statement: A Coach can see a list of the Trainees they oversee.

criteria.must: A Coach's trainee list shows every Trainee currently linked to them
A Coach's trainee list does not show a Trainee who has revoked the link

requirements.statement: A Coach can view a linked Trainee's logged meals, workouts, and progress against their targets.

criteria.must: A Coach can open a linked Trainee's food log entries
A Coach can open a linked Trainee's workout logs
A Coach can see a linked Trainee's progress against their macro targets
A Coach cannot view a Trainee who has not linked with them

requirements.statement: A Coach can leave feedback on a Trainee's day or log entry.

criteria.must: A Coach can submit a feedback message for a linked Trainee
A Coach cannot leave feedback for a Trainee they are not linked to

requirements.statement: A Trainee can see feedback their Coach has left so they can act on it.

criteria.must: Feedback a Coach submits appears in the Trainee's feedback inbox
The feedback inbox shows feedback in chronological order
